description:
This dataset maps annual land cover across Fiji to support Mineral Resource Detection (MRD): finding and monitoring mineral resources such as quarries. Each 10 m pixel is classified as bare land, forest, crops, grassland, settlements, mangroves, water or quarry, with the probability of the predicted class.

Lineage:
A random forest trained on labelled points from 2022, using Digital Earth Pacific Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1 annual geomedians, spectral indices, and Copernicus DEM elevation and terrain. Where Sentinel-1 isn't available for a tile and year, the classification is made without it and the item lists it in mrd:missing_inputs.

Processing level:
Thematic Classification

Dataset type:
Categorical map
